stem.text: An object of mass $m$, moving at speed $u$ along a frictionless horizontal surface, collides head-on with a stationary object of mass $4m$.

stem.alt: Two circles on a horizontal line: the left one labelled m with an arrow labelled u pointing right, the right one labelled 4m; caption: before the collision.

stem.text: After the collision, the object of mass $m$ rebounds along its initial path with $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of its kinetic energy before the collision.
What is the speed of the object of mass $4m$ after the collision?
